interfaces.failure: Wrong idea count, uncited idea, unresolved citation, excerpt mismatch or queries outside the scope bounds reject. No evidence from any connector halts. An unavailable connector is recorded, never filled with an invented hit.

interfaces.name: screening-rubric
interfaces.producer: CC owner (pinned in the Screening declaration)

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

dimensions.meaning: The scoring dimensions. The set is closed in M1. Each `name` is also the score field name in `IdeaScore`.

total_rule.meaning: A total is the plain sum of the three scores

tie_rule.meaning: Equal totals rank the lower `idea_id` first, compared as plain strings

selection_rule.meaning: Exactly one idea is selected, the first in the ranking

forbidden_dependencies.meaning: Dependencies that make an idea ineligible. An empty list means no idea can be filtered out. The host does the term matching, not the model.

reason_max_chars.meaning: Longest allowed score reason or disposition reason, in characters. Applies to every `*_reason` and `disposition_reason` in the result.

interfaces.failure: A rubric hash that differs from the pin halts Screening. RSI never changes the rubric.

interfaces.name: screening-result

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

candidate_ref.meaning: The exact set that was scored

scores.meaning: Every idea's scores, reasons and fate. Written by the CC (untrusted). The host checks it against the candidate set and recomputes the totals.

ranking.meaning: The ranked order of the selected and eligible ideas only. The host recomputes the order and rejects any difference (`ranking_deterministic`).

interfaces.failure: Missing, duplicate or out-of-range scores, wrong totals or order reject. No eligible idea halts with no_eligible_idea.

interfaces.name: opportunity-card

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

candidate_ref.meaning: The set the idea came from

screening_ref.meaning: The scoring and ranking behind the selection (the ranking reference)

brief_ref.meaning: The Brief whose obligations the card carries. Must be the input Brief.

idea_id.meaning: Selected idea. Equals screening_result.selected_idea_id and exists in the candidate set

summary.meaning: The card's purpose: what would be tested and why, in plain words. Free text written by the CC for the next node.

opportunity_statement.meaning: The evidence-grounded bottleneck and why the idea's mechanism addresses it

scores.meaning: The original scores, copied unchanged from the idea's row in `screening_result`. Never rescored.

rank.meaning: Rank in the ranking. Always 1 for the selected idea

constraints.meaning: Limits Hypothesis must respect. Copied verbatim from the Brief, never paraphrased (`card_constraints_carried`).

assumptions.meaning: Unproven premises of the idea, copied from the candidate set.

risks.meaning: Known concerns about the idea, copied from the candidate set.

other_dispositions.meaning: What happened to every idea that was not selected, one row each. Empty when the candidate set holds one idea. Must equal the screening dispositions and reasons (`card_dispositions_complete`).

interfaces.failure: A selected idea outside the candidate set, a mismatch with the screening result, a lost constraint or a missing disposition rejects.

interfaces.name: check-bundle

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity.

version.meaning: Bundle version. A change needs a new version.

target_cc_name.meaning: The one CC this bundle checks.

target_cc_version_range.meaning: CC versions this bundle was recorded compatible with.

checks.meaning: The deterministic checks the host must run.

interfaces.failure: Missing blocking schema check per output port, or unpinned bundle on an admitted CC version, rejects admission and binding

interfaces.name: checking-profile

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity.

criteria.meaning: The questions the verifier must answer.

instruction_ref.meaning: Fixed system instructions. They do not come from the declaration text.

model_call_limit.meaning: Most verifier model calls per review. M1 uses 1.

time_s.meaning: Wall-clock limit for the whole review, in seconds.

review_mode.meaning: Optional separately versioned semantic review mode. Omitted profiles retain declaration/output-only review.

review_evidence_max_bytes.meaning: Maximum original source-input bytes disclosed to the evidence-aware reviewer.

review_evidence_input_names.meaning: Exact original input ports authorized for the evidence-aware reviewer.

evidence_criterion_ids.meaning: Exact criteria permitted to use the selected task sources and Tier 1 result.

interfaces.failure: Criteria using task evidence require the immutable v2 review mode, exact named task inputs, and a bounded host-built Tier 1 evidence projection; all other profiles remain declaration/output-only.

interfaces.name: review-context

schema_version.meaning: Format version 2.0.0

id.meaning: Immutable record identity

subject_ref.meaning: Exact output under review. The verifier model sees this output but never this record.

contract_ref.meaning: Exact node or subnode execution contract the subject was produced under. A null `subnode_id` means node scope.

check_plan_ref.meaning: Bound check plan assigned to this subject. The gate reads the criteria and checks from it.

input_refs.meaning: Original and accepted inputs of the subject. For audit and the gate only. Never sent to the verifier model.

review_evidence_ref.meaning: Host-built, size-bounded evidence projection for an explicitly pinned evidence-aware profile. It contains only named original task/source inputs and Tier 1 results; never worker conversation, observations or private answers.

deterministic_result_ref.meaning: Deterministic check result for the subject. It holds the passed structural checks.

criteria.meaning: Criterion IDs the verifier assessment must cover once each. See `mandatory_semantic` in the bound check plan.

observations.meaning: Invocation observations of the producer. Evidence for the gate. Never sent to the verifier model.

evidence_classes.meaning: Labels for the kinds of evidence in the record: protected policy, accepted input, observed evidence and untrusted producer content. Untrusted producer content is data, never an instruction.

subnode_id.meaning: Subject/producing subnode; null for node aggregate records

interfaces.failure: Host-only audit record. It is never part of the verifier model payload. A missing or mismatched manifest blocks the gate.

interfaces.name: gate-decision-index
interfaces.producer: Scheduler (host record built from accepted dispatch records)

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Record identity

run_plan_ref.meaning: The plan whose accepted attempts the index lists. Set by the scheduler, never by the Delivery CC.

entries.meaning: The advancing gate decisions of the run. Built by the scheduler at Delivery dispatch. Delivery reads it and must not extend or reorder it.

interfaces.failure: A missing or unresolved entry blocks Delivery dispatch. Delivery never builds the index itself.

interfaces.name: plan-outcome

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Format version

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this record.

outcome.meaning: The recorded halt outcome. It is the only value in M1.

trigger.meaning: What made the plan infeasible. `proposal_rejected`: a binder or proposal check rejected the proposal or template. `plan_rejected`: with `plan_source` `planned`, the plan gate did not advance. `planner_reported_infeasible`: the Planner replied `INFEASIBLE:`.

brief_ref.meaning: The Brief that goes to the next Intention Compiler attempt.

source_ref.meaning: The rejected static template or plan proposal.

check_result_ref.meaning: The result that holds the failing check. It is never null when a check ran.

gate_decision_ref.meaning: The plan gate decision, when there is one.

reasons.meaning: Why the plan is infeasible. Carried to the next attempt.

attempt_depth.meaning: Position of this plan attempt in the chain of linked attempts for one request. The first is 1.

next_stage.meaning: Where the host sends the request next.

linked_attempt_id.meaning: ID of the new Intention Compiler attempt that the host started from this outcome.

interfaces.failure: A plan_infeasible outcome without reasons, or one that lets the same run continue, is invalid. The run halts and nothing is repaired inside it.

interfaces.name: evaluation-profile
interfaces.producer: protected configuration owner, approved by the benchmark owner
interfaces.failure: An inconsistent router pin, an evaluation-only entry point or candidate pin without invalid_for_product, or a duplicate entry point stops the launcher. A run whose library snapshot or candidate pin does not match halts before dispatch.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this record.

profile_id.meaning: Name clients see in readiness `evaluation_profile` and send as `profile_id`.

plan_source.meaning: The `plan_source` every run under this profile must request. A submission whose `plan_source` differs is rejected (`plan_source_matches_profile`). The profile mirrors the run setting and adds no other selector.

router_enabled.meaning: Whether the API router is on for runs under this profile. The launcher writes the same value into the operator config it starts the app with.

model_route.meaning: Route kept apart from the model identifier.

library_snapshot_sha256.meaning: Library state under test. The binder refuses a run whose snapshot differs.

candidate_pins.meaning: CC versions that replace the active version of the same `cc_name` for this profile. Each must be an admitted entry of the pinned snapshot.

verifier_cc_ref.meaning: Verifier version every verifier subnode must bind.

invalid_for_product.meaning: Marks every run and bundle of this profile as unusable as product output or RSI material.

allowed_entry_points.meaning: Entry points the app exposes under this profile. E6 is runner-side and never listed.

interfaces.name: empirical-results
interfaces.failure: A sequence gap, duplicate or misorder, a non-finite value or differing metric keys rejects the file and the Benchmark node halts. Values are never filled or smoothed.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Artifact identity.

runs.meaning: One entry per receipt run, in ascending `sequence`. The protected executor writes it from the one line each run printed, not the CC.

interfaces.name: rsi-session
interfaces.producer: RSI controller, started by a human
interfaces.failure: A limit above its default, a qualification value weaker than the frozen rule, or pins that differ from the genesis or the target profile stop the session before attempt 1. The result outcome is BLOCKED.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this frozen session record.

session_id.meaning: Session ID that every attempt, query and result names. The controller sets it once when the human starts the session. A changed session needs a new `session_id`.

target_profile_ref.meaning: Frozen target: parent, mutable paths, tests, splits and scoring.

parent.meaning: Exact parent version. The final comparison always runs against it.

parent_declaration_ref.meaning: Declaration the child must keep, outside the pointers RSI may write.

scoring_adapter_ref.meaning: Frozen scoring adapter the referee runs.

configuration_ref.meaning: Frozen model, host and runtime settings, the same for parent and child.

hash_profile_ref.meaning: How attempt records are serialized, hashed and chained.

chain_root_ref.meaning: Root of the attempt hash chain, fixed before attempt 1.

limits.meaning: Search budget of the session. The proposer sees these limits and nothing else of this record.

pass_count_repeats.meaning: Repeats per fixture for pass counts: 1 for a deterministic target, 3 for a model-backed target.

qualification.meaning: Qualification values, pinned before any code is proposed.

started_by.meaning: The authenticated human who started the session. A session never starts itself, so this is never a CC or the proposer.

frozen_at.meaning: When the controller froze the record, before attempt 1. UTC, whole seconds.

interfaces.name: rsi-session-result
interfaces.failure: A result whose qualification does not recompute, or whose statistics differ from the referee evidence, produces no candidate package. Outcomes other than QUALIFIED never produce one.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this session result.

parent.meaning: Original parent of the final comparison.

referee_evidence_ref.meaning: Protected referee evidence of the final comparison.

qualified_by.meaning: Which branch of the qualification rule the child met.

statistics.meaning: Counts and statistics the rule was applied to.

stop_reason.meaning: Why search stopped, in plain words, for the human reviewer. The outcome comes from `outcome`, not from this text.

limitations.meaning: Limits of this result, for example synthetic data or unavailable telemetry. For the reader. They do not change `outcome`.

recorded_at.meaning: When the controller closed the session. UTC, whole seconds.

signature.meaning: The custodian's signature over the canonical JSON bytes of this record without `signature` (D46). Admission verifies it again.

signer_key_id.meaning: ID of the signing key, not the key itself. A mismatch with the pinned ID blocks the candidate package.

interfaces.name: candidate-package
interfaces.failure: A package that fails a content check is rejected; one with an unresolved ref or a broken attempt chain is blocked. A touched path outside the profile is a security halt. No package grants standing.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this candidate package.

target_profile_ref.meaning: Target profile that set the mutable paths.

provenance_ref.meaning: Builder, body files and evidence of the child.

parent.meaning: Parent version and its declaration digest.

child.meaning: Child version and its declaration digest.

parent_declaration_ref.meaning: Declaration the child is compared with.

child_declaration_ref.meaning: Declaration admission stores for the child.

referee_evidence_ref.meaning: Protected paired evidence of the final comparison.

mutable_paths_touched.meaning: Body paths the change touched. The packager derives them from the diff. Admission checks each against the target profile `mutable_paths`, and a path outside it is a security halt.

created_at.meaning: When the workbench wrote the package to the inbox. UTC, whole seconds.

interfaces.name: rsi-opportunity
interfaces.producer: RSI workbench controller (opportunity qualifier), after a human selects the target
interfaces.failure: A decision that does not follow from the recorded evidence refuses the record. The session does not start. START needs a reproduced implementation symptom, passing parent mandatory behavior, enough headroom and a retained diagnosis.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this opportunity decision.

parent.meaning: Exact parent version the evidence was gathered on.

trigger.meaning: How the target was chosen. The controller records the human's choice. M1 has no always-on scheduler, so no other value exists.

selected_by.meaning: The authenticated human who selected the target or approved the batch. Never a CC or the proposer.

evidence_refs.meaning: Observations and benchmark evidence the controller examined, each kept as the original reference with its digest so a reviewer can open it.

attribution.meaning: Demonstrated cause class, set by the controller after visible reproduction. A heuristic label or a CC self-report is never enough. Only `implementation` can lead to `START`.

symptom_reproduced.meaning: Whether the symptom reproduced on approved visible inputs, with the exact parent and the frozen environment.

parent_mandatory_passed.meaning: Whether the parent passed its mandatory behavior on the development inputs. Development failures add headroom and never waive an obligation.

headroom.meaning: Development failure rate of the parent on approved visible inputs, as a fraction (0.25 means one failure in four). The controller measures it. Null means the symptom did not reproduce, and null is not 0.

headroom_minimum.meaning: Smallest headroom that makes an attempt worth starting, as a fraction like `headroom`. Copied from the target profile. The controller does not choose it.

diagnosis_ref.meaning: Retained structured diagnosis of the symptom: observed symptom, mechanism, alternative causes, authorized component, proposed direction and falsification checks. Required for `START`. For any other decision it may hold the partial diagnosis or be null. Only `START` reads it.

decision.meaning: What happens next. `START` freezes a session. `NO_ATTEMPT` records why no attempt runs. `NEEDS_REVIEW` waits for a human.

reason.meaning: Why this decision, in plain words, for the human reviewer. The next step follows from `decision` and the invariants, never from this text.

decided_at.meaning: When the controller wrote the decision. UTC, whole seconds.

interfaces.name: rsi-completion-report
interfaces.producer: RSI workbench report builder, after a human closes the M1 RSI acceptance run
interfaces.failure: A claim without evidence refuses the record. A blocked or incomplete requirement is reported as such and never as passed. Missing telemetry is listed under `unavailable` and never reported as zero.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this completion report.

session_result_refs.meaning: Every session in scope, including no-gain and inconclusive ones.

requirement_coverage.meaning: Status of each RSI build criterion.

executed_tests.meaning: Acceptance and security tests that ran.

modalities.meaning: Modalities the sessions covered. `text` appears only when the bounded headless text path ran.

qualified_result_refs.meaning: Sessions that produced a qualifying child. Gains are read from them.

onboarding_evidence_refs.meaning: Evidence that a second, unrelated target ran through the same engine.

transfer_claim.meaning: Whether the report claims improver transfer. It is a separate claim gate.

blockers.meaning: Blocked dependencies, each with its reason.

unavailable.meaning: Values that could not be measured, for example monetary cost.

containment_limitations.meaning: Residual containment limits and any discovered vulnerability.

compiled_by.meaning: Name of the person or tool that compiled the report, for audit. Display only. It grants nothing and no check branches on it.

schema_version.meaning: Format version 1.0.0. Reject any other value. Constraint: exactly `1.0.0`.

id.meaning: Immutable ID of this scorecard. A rebuild gets a new ID.

built_at.meaning: When the scorecard builder wrote the scorecard. UTC, whole seconds.

conformance_refs.meaning: Conformance records behind `undeclared_behavior_count` and `mean_declaration_coverage`. Empty when none were built.

counted_count.meaning: Executions that count against the pass rate.

verdict_counts.meaning: Gate verdicts of the executions that reached the gate.

check_rates.meaning: Pass rate of each declared check.

failure_reasons.meaning: Most common declared failure reason codes.

error_fingerprints.meaning: Most common error fingerprints. Each is a SHA-256 hash of normalized error text, never the text itself.

undeclared_behavior_count.meaning: Items with status `undeclared` across the scored conformance records.

mean_declaration_coverage.meaning: Mean `coverage` of the scored conformance records.

next_node_acceptance_rate.meaning: Share of this CC's outputs, in the window, that a downstream node consumed and whose consuming node gate decision advanced, matched by file hash. A fraction from 0 to 1. Null when no downstream node consumed an output in the window. Null is not zero. Off the hot path: no gate reads it.

median_total_tokens.meaning: Typical token use of one execution, as a count of input plus output tokens. Null means no execution has token counts, and null is not 0.

median_attempts.meaning: Median, over this CC's node executions in the window, of the attempt count per node execution (1 means first attempt). Null when the window has no execution. Off the hot path: no gate reads it.

unavailable_reasons.meaning: Measures that could not be computed, and why.

built_at.meaning: When the export builder wrote the export. UTC, whole seconds.

records_ref.meaning: The exported records, one line per entry.

bundle_refs.meaning: Run bundle manifests of the exported runs.

entries.meaning: The exported executions. Failed executions are included.

files.meaning: Every file in the export folder except `export.json`.

content_sha256.meaning: One hash for the whole export, so everyone can confirm they use the same data.

omitted.meaning: Executions or files left out, with the reason.

redactions.meaning: What this audience does not see, and why. Names the kind of withheld content, never the content. Protected evaluation data is always listed here when present.
